_comment: Saved to ~/realtor-brain/editor/config.json by studio-setup. This is the SAME config file the Descript editor (Plugin 6) uses — the brand block is shared so both engines look identical. Only the Riverside connection is required for this plugin; everything else is optional.
_default_engine_comment: Which video editor owns a plain 'edit my video' when BOTH engines are installed: 'riverside' (the AI Editing Studio) or 'descript' (Plugin 6). Saying the engine's name always wins.

riverside.note: Connected in Claude → Settings → Connectors → Riverside. No API key is stored here.

descript.note: Filled by the Descript editor's setup if that engine is also installed. Leave blank otherwise.

_brand_source_comment: FALLBACK POINTER ONLY — where the brand block below gets refreshed FROM. Skills read the 'brand' block below at edit time (resolution order #1).
_brand_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the editor's brand (both engines). Setup writes the captured colours/font here. If blank, readers fall back to the Brain's identity/brand-visual.md, then tasteful defaults. There is NO separate brand.json file.

sfx.note: Optional. Riverside has no built-in SFX library reachable from the connector. If the agent drops a licensed swoosh (MP3/WAV) into Your Media, record its media id here and the energy pass uses it.

riverside_stock.note: Built in (Pexels via Riverside). No key needed.

_publish_route_comment: ONE posting route per post. 'riverside' = Riverside's connected accounts (studio-publish). 'shortform-tool' = the Short-Form System's Metricool/GoHighLevel/Buffer. Long-form YouTube can use 'riverside' while reels use the short-form tool; never both for the same post.

preferences._comment: Learned from revisions (Review and Revise, Audio Enhance). Each new video starts here.
